subject: Knowledge capture and legal hold for Evan Brooks (Vendico project)
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Urgent: proposed involuntary separation — Evan Brooks (Vendico lead)

Marcus / Mina —

I need to escalate a sensitive personnel action for Evan Brooks (Sr. SWE on the Vendico integration). Over the last 6 weeks we've documented repeated policy violations (unauthorized data pull from a Prod analytics cluster, missed remediation plans, and two formal PIPs without sufficient improvement). The security team flagged a suspicious export that may include Vendico customer identifiers.

Because Evan has deep ownership of the Vendico production deploy (keys, runbooks, and cross-account roles), we need to coordinate:
- legal hold on Evan's email/drive/slack + preserve device images
- immediate snapshot of credentials and privileged sessions for the Vendico environment
- rapid knowledge-capture for live handoffs to avoid customer impact
- proposed severance terms to avoid escalation if we proceed with involuntary separation

I am asking HR and Legal to advise next steps — we want to move carefully but quickly this week. I've attached an initial termination paperwork draft and a knowledge-capture template for the handoff.

Thanks,
Karthik

--
Karthik Iyer
Director, Engineering (Integrations)
Redwood Inference
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 10:02:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Urgent: proposed involuntary separation — Evan Brooks (Vendico lead)

Karthik / Marcus —

Thanks for the heads-up. HR can initiate the separation workflow as soon as Legal signs off on the legal-hold language and the proposed severance. A few immediate asks from HR:
1) Please confirm whether we are treating this as involuntary termination or summary suspension pending investigation. That will affect pay/notice and the paperwork language.
2) Provide the suggested severance package (weeks of pay, COBRA/K, stock treatment, revocation/vesting language).
3) Confirm whether we need to loop in external counsel (Axiom) — Neha, tagging you for advice.

I've attached our knowledge-capture template and the termination_paperwork_draft you sent (marked up HR placeholder fields). I will hold the paperwork until Legal confirms.

If we proceed, HR will request a locked mailbox + litigation hold and coordinate with IT to freeze device access while preserving images.

-Mina

--
Mina Haddad
Head of People Ops
Redwood Inference
Attachments: knowledge_capture_template.docx, termination_paperwork_draft.pdf
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 12:40:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Urgent: proposed involuntary separation — Evan Brooks (Vendico lead)

Team —

Agree we need a controlled, documented process. Legal recommends the following immediate steps (before any in-person meeting with the employee):
- Issue a litigation hold preserving all Evan's accounts (Gmail Drive, Slack, workstation images, AWS access logs). HR should send the hold notice (we'll draft).
- Coordinate with Security (Soojin) to snapshot AWS CloudTrail, S3 logs, and any DB export logs related to the flagged timeframe.
- Do NOT delete any artifacts; preserve backups and set retention overrides where possible.
- Prepare a sealed copy of the proposed severance offer that HR can present if/when termination is finalized. Keep the offer neutral language (involuntary separation with customary release).

I recommend looping external counsel at Axiom for the data export (Vendico PI risk) and any client-notification obligations. Marcus — please confirm whether Vendico has contract clauses that require notification on unauthorized exports; if so, Legal will draft the client notice and timing.

I'll draft the litigation-hold letter this morning and circulate.

Neha

--
Neha Kapoor
Senior Counsel, Employment & Privacy
Redwood Inference
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 09:10:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Urgent: proposed involuntary separation — Evan Brooks (Vendico lead)

Neha / Mina / Karthik —

Security will execute the following this morning:
1) Snapshot credentials: rotate service-account keys used by the Vendico integration and export current IAM role bindings to a sealed archive (access_snapshot_runbook.txt attached).
2) Preserve logs: take a point-in-time copy of CloudTrail, S3 access logs, and any query logs from the analytics cluster.
3) Suspend interactive access for Evan (disable AWS console and revoke SSH keys) but DO NOT wipe the device. We'll image the laptop and ship it to forensics if Legal requests.
4) Capture Slack export for Evan (we'll work with Slack to ensure hold) and map any file shares he had in Drive.

Estimated timeline: snapshots and access suspension complete by 11/23 17:00 PT. I'll send hashes for the archived snapshots and confirm storage location (internal evidence bucket).

Soojin

--
Soojin Lee
Head of Security Engineering
Redwood Inference
Attachments: access_snapshot_runbook.txt
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Axiom Advisors <legal@axiomadvisors.com>, Joanna Park <joanna@vendico.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 14:02:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Urgent: proposed involuntary separation — Evan Brooks (Vendico lead)

Thanks all — appreciate the quick turn. Quick summary and action items (for visibility with Vendico):
- Legal will finalize litigation-hold language (Neha) and advise on client notification.
- HR to prepare sealed severance offer: I'm proposing 6 weeks pay + 3 months COBRA, standard release language. Mina to confirm wording.
- Security to snapshot logs and suspend access by EOD 11/23 (Soojin) — please post archive hashes in the evidence bucket.
- Knowledge-capture: Karthik and I will run an accelerated handoff using the attached knowledge_capture_template.docx; goal is to have a 1.5 hour deep-dive with the interim owner (Laura Bennett) and produce an operational runbook for Vendico by 11/25.

Marcus — action for you: once Legal signs the hold and HR bundles the severance offer, schedule the offboarding meeting. I will coordinate the client communication draft if Legal recommends notifying Vendico; otherwise, we will keep client contact limited until the investigation clarifies exposure.

Forwarding the attachments again for reference.

Regards,
Marcus Lin
Senior Engineering Manager, Integrations
Redwood Inference
